parsed.summary: The PR addresses the issue of non-converged affinity propagation clustering by adding a flag to check if the algorithm has converged. The change is minimal and does not introduce any apparent regressions or compatibility issues.

issues.description: The code could be slightly more readable by adding a comment explaining the purpose of the `never_converged` flag.
